```{ojs}
//| echo: false
geo_data = FileAttachment("/data/hero_geometry.json").json().catch(() => null)
geo_loadFailed = geo_data === null ? html`<p class="figcaption"><strong>${t("failed")}</strong></p><img src="/assets/img/hero_geometry.png" alt="${geo_S.fallbackAlt}" style="width:100%">` : html``
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
geo_S = LANG === "zh" ? ({
  names: [["参与维数", "pd"], ["最大方向所占份额", "share"], ["条件数", "cond"], ["谱漂移", "drift"]],
  pd: "参与维数（大致相当于多少个同等大小的变动方向）", share: "最大方向所占份额（%）", cond: "条件数（对数坐标）", drift: "谱漂移（逐月变化）",
  aria: "特征尺子 EWMA 版本的逐月统计量",
  desc: (l) => `特征尺子指数加权移动平均（EWMA）版本（格拉姆度量）的${l}，1973 年 6 月至 2024 年 11 月每月一个数值，阴影为 NBER 衰退期。`,
  fallbackAlt: "特征尺子 EWMA 版本的参与维数，1973 年 6 月至 2024 年 11 月，阴影为 NBER 衰退期"
}) : ({
  names: [["Participation dimension", "pd"], ["Largest direction's share", "share"], ["Condition number", "cond"], ["Spectral drift", "drift"]],
  pd: "Participation dimension (about how many equally large directions of variation)", share: "Largest direction's share (%)", cond: "Condition number (log axis)", drift: "Spectral drift (month on month)",
  aria: "Monthly statistics of the EWMA version of the characteristic ruler",
  desc: (l) => `${l} of the EWMA version of the characteristic ruler (Gram metric), one value per month from June 1973 to November 2024, with NBER recessions shaded.`,
  fallbackAlt: "Participation dimension of the EWMA version of the characteristic ruler, June 1973 to November 2024, NBER recessions shaded"
})
viewof geo_stat = Inputs.select(new Map(geo_S.names), { value: "pd", label: t("statistic") })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Labels are localised through LANG. `share` is stored as a fraction and drawn in percent;
// the condition number spans 1,735 to 13,747 and is drawn on a log axis.
geo_spec = ({
  pd: { label: geo_S.pd, scale: 1, type: "linear", fmt: fmt2 },
  share: { label: geo_S.share, scale: 100, type: "linear", fmt: fmt2 },
  cond: { label: geo_S.cond, scale: 1, type: "log", fmt: (x) => Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en") },
  drift: { label: geo_S.drift, scale: 1, type: "linear", fmt: (x) => x.toFixed(5) }
})
geo_months = geo_data ? geo_data.months.map(parseMonth) : []
geo_nber = geo_data ? geo_data.nber.map(([a, b]) => ({ start: geo_data.months[a], end: geo_data.months[b] })) : []
geo_rows = geo_data ? geo_data[geo_stat].map((v, i) => ({ date: geo_months[i], value: v * geo_spec[geo_stat].scale })) : []
geo_median = geo_data && geo_data.meta.medians[geo_stat] != null ? geo_data.meta.medians[geo_stat] * geo_spec[geo_stat].scale : null
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
geo_chart = {
  if (!geo_data) return html``
  const s = geo_spec[geo_stat]
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 300, marginLeft: 60, style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 },
    ariaLabel: geo_S.aria,
    ariaDescription: geo_S.desc(s.label),
    x: { label: null },
    y: { label: s.label, type: s.type, grid: true },
    marks: [
      nberMarks(geo_nber),
      geo_median == null ? null : Plot.ruleY([geo_median], { stroke: palette.muted, strokeDasharray: "3 3" }),
      Plot.lineY(geo_rows, { x: "date", y: "value", stroke: palette.naipca_iab, strokeWidth: 1.6 }),
      Plot.tip(geo_rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "value", title: (d) => `${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}\n${s.label}: ${s.fmt(d.value)}` }))
    ]
  })
}
```
